name: print-social-sage-green-circle-diagram-post
title: Sage green post with photo in a circle ringed by broken orbit and asterisk labels
whatItIs: A 4:5 post on sage green with a giant white uppercase headline. A circular photo of a woman meditating in mountains sits in the middle, surrounded by a thin white ring broken by five asterisk-marked words. A small logo sits at the base.
whatItMeans: Serene and thoughtful; the ring suggests connected areas of life around a centre.
techniques: Break a thin outer ring at each label so words sit on the orbit.
Crop the hero photo to a perfect circle at the centre.
Use an asterisk as a small bullet glyph.
Keep the palette to one green plus white for calm.
bestFor: Concept diagrams with a central idea

vocabulary.definition: A thin circle around a subject, with labels on it.
A photo masked to a circle.
A star-like mark used as a list marker.
A layout where topics surround a centre.
